thread:
mira: Quick sync — we're planning a v3 audit event rollout to add `actor_identity` and remove `legacy_user_id`. Who's on board for schema gating + KMS visibility checks?

dan: I'm in. A couple questions: do we require `event_version` as top-level semver or integer?

mira: Prefer integer (e.g. 2 -> 3) to keep clients simple. We'll map it to semver in docs.

sana: +1 on integer. Also need clarity on RBAC: if `actor_identity` can be a service principal, do we include `principal_type` and `principal_id` separately?

mira: yes — plan is `principal_type` enum (user, service, key) and `principal_id` opaque string. That lets us avoid leaking emails in some customers.

oliver: KMS note: for key-rotations we need to surface `kms_key_id` in the event for customer auditability, but it must be redacted for hosted customers unless they opt in.

sana: good call. we should add `kms_key_id` and `kms_key_version` optional fields, default masked. add masking policy to migration playbook. :lock:

mira: Migration/gating proposal: 1) v3 schema accepted by runtime 2) internal canary (10% of traffic, dedicated logs) 3) send opt-in customer test feed for validation 4) full cutover after 2w of no regressions.

dan: How will we validate customer-facing events? we should publish a validation harness (small endpoint + schema diff) so customers can run their validators against v3 before cutover.

mira: Exactly. We should provide a downloadable JSON schema + an npm/python validator and a small `audit-validate` CLI.

oliver: Also need to update audit-bot to annotate event_version in the logs. audit-bot: scheduled job added to tag events during canary.

audit-bot: FYI — will emit `audit.bot.tag` when events are part of canary.

sana: Vulnerability triage note: if we remove `legacy_user_id`, keep it in the payload for 30 days in a compatibility header `X-Audit-Legacy` to help security tools; plan a hard delete after 30 days.

dan: Incident response: in case the canary shows increased error rates, have fallback policy to route to v2 model and emit `rollback_reason` in the incident ticket.

mira: I'll draft migration checklist: schema PR + changelog, runtime validation, canary config, customer validator publish, KMS masking opt-in, RBAC docs, 30-day legacy header, rollback runbook.

oliver: I'll take KMS masking and audit-bot changes. sana you take RBAC docs and validator. dan you own the rollback runbook and canary config.

mira: Thanks. I'll post the checklist + timeline by EOD tomorrow. If anyone finds a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:

dan: Quick snippet for the validator example:
```
{
  "event_version": 3,
  "timestamp": "2025-11-12T15:04:05Z",
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "principal_type": "service",
  "principal_id": "svc-abc123",
  "actor_identity": {"id":"svc-abc123","display":"deploy-bot"},
  "kms_key_id": "redwood:keys/abcd",
  "details": {"model":"redwood/rt-1"}
}
```

sana: great. we'll also include a negative test where `actor_identity` missing should fail for customers who opt into strict validation.

mira: perfect. closing this thread after checklist posted. thanks all!
